MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The metric nuts and bolts assortment matches my recent interest in small fasteners, especially the overlapping M3, M4 and M5 sizes.",
    "That kit fits the practical fastening needs reflected in my washer and screw purchases, although I would skip it today because I recently bought a similar assortment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors and heat-shrink tubing require a wiring task; buying hardware does not mean I currently need to repair or insulate wires.",
    "Capacitors assume an electronics project that my screw purchases do not establish.",
    "Wastebaskets, large garbage cans, disposable gloves and COVID-19 tests do not follow from my recent interest in fasteners and magnetic hooks."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few practical hardware supplies seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any workplace or maintenance supply.",
    "The mention of electronics in a screw kit seems to have been taken as evidence that I need circuit components and wiring supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases cluster around fastening and hanging items, with repeated interest in magnetic hooks.",
    "A recently purchased fastener assortment can already cover my needs, so a close match is not necessarily something I want to buy again now.",
    "I rarely interact unless something meets a clear need; a possible use in some future project is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in fasteners but stretched it into unrelated supplies and missed that my recent kit may already meet my needs."
}
